sources.entry: Espresso - The web editor for Mac is back. For people who make delightful, innovative and fast websites.

summary.name: Espresso
summary.one_liner: Espresso is a web editor for Mac for writing, coding, designing, and publishing websites, with live preview and server sync.
use_cases: Writing and editing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on a Mac
Previewing local or live sites with auto-refresh
Editing CSS on a live site without publishing
Building static sites with auto-building from SCSS, LESS, or Markdown
Publishing or syncing project files to a server or CDN
summary.what_it_does: Espresso is a Mac web editor covering text editing, coding, styling, building, and publishing. Its Live Preview works with Chrome, Firefox, and Safari, with auto-refresh for local projects and Xray for inspecting page layout and styles. Live Styling lets users change CSS on live sites and see updates in real time without saving or publishing. Its CSSEdit tools provide visual editors for colors, gradients, shadows, and layouts for standard CSS, SCSS, and LESS. Dynamo is a built-in build system that auto-builds content, and Server Sync, Quick Publish, and Cloud Attack handle uploads and CDN pushes.
notable: Live Preview and Xray with Live Styling overrides on live sites, non-destructive
CSSEdit visual tools for standard CSS, SCSS, and LESS
Dynamo built-in static build infrastructure with auto-building
Server Sync with parallel transfers and CDN folder pushes
caveats: Some features, such as folder template mixins, are in beta and may change significantly
Pricing is not stated on the page
